notes: Cross-verse reconciliation of the verbless-clause copula. The chapter puts the construction-supplied copula on the predicate in DEU.18.3, DEU.18.12 and DEU.18.22, as rule 20 directs; DEU.18.2 alone put it on the resuming subject pronoun הוּא. The ASV realizes this clause's subject once, as 'Jehovah', so הוּא is the unrendered occurrence under rule 22 and the copula joins the predicate נַחֲלָת, discontinuous around the suffix's 'their' under rule 25 — the same division DEU.18.22 already carries for הוּא הַדָּבָר.
